name: Johann Wedgwood
source:
The older brother of the twins who lives inside the rose mansion.
He’s the one who is responsible for taking care of the garden and the inheritance from their parents.
The love he has for his younger is unrivalled.
He’s willing to give up and sacrifice anything as long as he can stay with his brother.

[From Google Play Store]
